# Identity Continuity Requirements Checklist: Approved Identity Construction Continuity

**Purpose**: Review whether S027 requirements completely and unambiguously protect approval fidelity, identity preservation, migration safety, and bounded publication
**Created**: 2026-09-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Approval Lifecycle Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are direction selection and canonical-master approval defined as distinct states with unambiguous authority boundaries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are all prerequisites for canonical approval enumerated for full and reduced masters? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003-FR-006]
- [x] CHK003 Are the owner decision, source revision, timestamps, scope, and governed hashes required consistently? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004-FR-005]
- [x] CHK004 Are every permitted lifecycle transition and every invalidation path specified without an implicit bypass? [Coverage, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK005 Is derivative eligibility clearly prohibited before canonical approval and byte-preserving promotion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007-FR-010, §FR-020]
- [x] CHK006 Does the spec address contradictory work orders that prohibit construction before purported final approval? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-029]

## Source and Identity Preservation

- [x] CHK007 Is byte-preserving promotion distinguished clearly from copying generated artifacts or reconstructing geometry? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007-FR-009]
- [x] CHK008 Are all governed drift classes enumerated consistently across requirements, edge cases, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK009 Are constructed and imported identities given distinct, complete provenance requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011-FR-012]
- [x] CHK010 Is the prohibition against redesigning, normalizing, or manually editing shipped geometry explicit for every migration path? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024-FR-027]
- [x] CHK011 Are historical evidence limitations separated from claims of retrospective approval? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK012 Can preservation outcomes be measured objectively for every existing production identity? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Visual and Palette Evidence

- [x] CHK013 Are master variants, proof sizes, and surface treatments exhaustively specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK014 Are all visual comparison evidence families named and tied to governed comparison families? [Traceability, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK015 Is exact same-renderer equality distinguished unambiguously from calibrated cross-renderer comparison? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015-FR-017]
- [x] CHK016 Are exact cross-renderer structural invariants separated from bounded perceptual measurements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK017 Does the spec require calibration evidence for both equivalent and known-divergent cases before thresholds become normative? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-017, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK018 Are every accessibility, sibling-separation, color-vision, semantic, surface, single-ink, and rendered-color qualification requirement present before approval? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK019 Are approval packets required to expose enough evidence for owner judgment without relying on hidden verifier state? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019]

## Failure and Security Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Is fail-closed behavior defined for missing, stale, malformed, contradictory, and incomplete evidence? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK021 Are path traversal, root escape, symlink escape, executable declaration, malformed hash, duplicate key, and unauthorized destination threats all represented? [Security, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK022 Is recovery from invalidation defined as a return to canonical approval rather than an automatic repair? [Recovery, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK023 Are renderer-upgrade edge cases separated between harmless edge variation and structural identity change? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 Is third-party review handling consistent with the nondelegable owner authority over identity changes? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-034]

## Migration and Delivery Boundaries

- [x] CHK025 Is every production brand required to receive one authoritative-source classification and explicit migration disposition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024-FR-027]
- [x] CHK026 Are generated evidence, approval packets, audit output, kits, registries, archives, and exports consistently excluded from committed source? [Consistency, Spec §FR-030]
- [x] CHK027 Are accessibility, zero-problem kit verification, zero-failure glyph validation, encoding, and identity-preservation gates all measurable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-031-FR-033, §SC-008]
- [x] CHK028 Are consumer repositories, domain activation, redesign, release, deployment, and merge authority excluded explicitly? [Scope, Spec §FR-034]
- [x] CHK029 Are push authorization, issue closure, review response, review-round ceiling, green CI, and owner merge gate specified consistently? [Completeness, Spec §FR-035-FR-037]
- [x] CHK030 Does the traceability section identify the defect record, known regression history, and current operator authority without stale pre-merge assumptions? [Traceability, Spec §Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.

- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
